name: timetree-mcp
description: Read and manage your TimeTree calendars, events, memos, and comments from Claude.
long_description:
Ask Claude about your TimeTree calendars: summarize this week's schedule, find conflicts, search past events, add or change events and memos, and see who changed what.

**Unofficial.** This extension is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by TimeTree, Inc. It uses the TimeTree web app's undocumented endpoints, which may change or stop working at any time. Use it with your own personal account only.

Your email and password are sent only to TimeTree to sign in. The session stays in memory and is never written to disk by this extension.

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Read events with date, keyword, and label filters; expands recurring events.

tools.name: get_updated_events
tools.description: Find events changed after a point in time.

tools.name: get_holidays
tools.description: Look up public holidays by country and date range.

tools.name: get_recent_activity
tools.description: See recent changes and who made them.

email.title: TimeTree email
email.description: The email address you use to sign in to TimeTree.

password.title: TimeTree password
password.description: Sent only to TimeTree to sign in.
